name: Anti-spoof and lie detection
plain: Detects when privacy tools or anti-detect browsers have replaced browser functions.
meaning: Checks native toString, prototype descriptors and cross-signal consistency (WebGL renderer versus user agent). Finds noise injection, so being protected becomes a fingerprint of its own.

steps: Compare function strings to native pattern
Re-read the API in a fresh iframe or worker

limits.headline: Can tell when a privacy tool or anti detect browser changed your browser's answers
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when the page loads
can: Check if built in browser functions were replaced
Compare answers across signals to spot a mismatch, such as graphics card versus browser label
Spot random noise added by privacy tools
Treat being protected as another trait that sets you apart

story.what_it_is: A script detects when privacy tools or special browsers have replaced built in browser functions.
story.for_you: You never see it. The page tests whether normal browser functions have been swapped out by an add on, a privacy tool or an anti detect browser. If so, you may face more checks or be blocked.
story.for_makers: Fraud teams use it to spot people hiding their identity. Fingerprint vendors use it to find users who use privacy tools. It lets a site treat a spoofer as higher risk, or target them anyway.

use_cases.example: A bank spots that a login came from a tool that replaces browser values, and requires video or ID checks.
A checkout sees a browser whose canvas function was replaced and routes the order to review.
An ad verifier finds bots that fake human browsers to click on ads, so the advertiser is not billed.
A browser game finds players using tools that fake devices to farm bonuses.
A sneaker or ticket site finds scalpers using anti detect browsers with many fake profiles.
A fingerprint library flags visitors with tampered values, so counts are cleaner.
A dating site blocks fake profile farms that use anti detect browsers.

technical_bounds: Arms race, advanced tools hide well

value.abuse: Defeat protection tools, label privacy users
